headline: Kajetan Schweighofer breaks into ARC-2 gold

sections.text: Kajetan Schweighofer gained 13.89 to reach 47.92, vaulting from 32nd to 12th and into the 15 gold places. ibyyue slipped from 15th to 16th at 41.81, just outside.
The cut moved with Schweighofer’s surge: the gold line now sits at 41.81, with ibyyue level on score but 0.00 short of a place.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
